pages.summary: El grupo regresa. Hermione lleva a Pansy con Robin y espera que el hechizo se disipe.

panels.scene: Four friends emerge from one silvery invisibility cloak at the common-room entry. Hermione, Daphne, Tracey with one little dark Puffskein, and Astoria. Blaise by green chair watches, surprised.
panels.caption: De vuelta en la sala común de Slytherin.

panels.scene: Tracey explains to Blaise, high brown ponytail, both fully dressed. Astoria nods. Puffskein now sits sleepily on green chair arm beside them.
dialogue: Tracey: Lavender tiene un giratiempo.

panels.scene: Daphne speaks quietly beside Hermione by fireplace, own long blonde waves. Both smile, no physical contact, background friends naturally distant.
dialogue: Daphne: Aprendes rápido, Granger.

panels.scene: Hermione gently gathers one sleeping charcoal Puffskein from green armrest, supporting it in both arms. Its green eyes barely open.
panels.caption: Pansy se había quedado dormida.

panels.scene: Cut to under-lake bedroom. Nodky, short adult male elf in neat beige, stands next to single moon-star crib with sleeping human Robin. A few blocks and storybooks neatly on low table. Hermione carries Puffskein.
dialogue: Nodky: Robin durmió todo el rato.

panels.scene: Hermione sits fully clothed in green armchair by one crib and under-lake window. Puffskein sleeps safely on a small cushion on armrest near her, separate from Robin.
dialogue: Hermione: Espero que mañana vuelvas a ser tú.

pages.summary: Con la mañana, Pansy recupera su forma humana y recuerda lo que Hermione dijo en la escalera.

panels.scene: Dawn light through blue-green underwater arches. Single crib with sleeping human Robin, green armchair with small dark Puffskein sleeping on a cushion. A few faint gold sparks show the magic fading.
panels.caption: Al amanecer, el hechizo perdió fuerza.

panels.scene: Time cut after fading. Pansy is human again, standing near the window in full forest green sweater and dark trousers. Exact chin-length sleek black bob, green eyes and angular jaw. Hermione fully dressed in burgundy turns toward her.
dialogue: Hermione: ¿Pansy?

panels.scene: Pansy smiles softly, green eyes, black bob and bare ears. Mid-shot with entire high neck green sweater visible. No Puffskein now.
dialogue: Pansy: Nunca me fui, Granger.

panels.scene: Both seated in separate chairs by window, fully dressed. Pansy looks directly at Hermione, gentle and serious. The bed stays distant background only.
dialogue: Pansy: Oí lo que dijiste ayer. Cada palabra.

panels.scene: Hermione answers with small warm smile, brown eyes and freckles. Their hands gently clasp above the low table, exactly two natural hands visible for this gesture.
dialogue: Hermione: Lo dije en serio.

panels.scene: Both turn toward oak door as it is knocked on from corridor. Robin still safely in own crib in background, morning light and normal clothes.
panels.caption: Tres golpes rompieron la calma.

pages.summary: Ginny y Astoria avisan que ya son casi las diez. Robin despierta al oírlas.

panels.scene: From bedroom toward oak door. Pansy and Hermione standing fully dressed, door still closed. Astoria's voice from corridor.
dialogue: Astoria, fuera de cuadro: ¿Están ahí adentro?

panels.scene: Oak door opens, Ginny copper hair and Astoria brown stand just inside in complete school uniforms. They see Pansy human and smile, Hermione by window.
dialogue: Ginny: Daphne nos mandó a buscarlas.

panels.scene: Astoria casually checks a small watch with one hand, Hermione and Pansy look puzzled.
dialogue: Astoria: Son casi las diez.

panels.scene: Two shocked fully dressed protagonists in medium close-up, Hermione and Pansy each with her own clearly distinct face. One shared balloon with two tails.
dialogue: Hermione y Pansy: ¡¿Las diez?!

panels.scene: Robin yawns in his own crib and blinks green eyes. Brown curls, cream blanket partly over navy cardigan, tiny human hands. Hermione smiles down at him.
panels.caption: Robin también dio por terminada la mañana tranquila.

panels.scene: Hermione supports Robin safely at chest, speaking to two visitors in uniform. Ginny grins; Astoria slightly embarrassed. Pansy beside the crib.
dialogue: Hermione: ¿Y ustedes por qué no están en clase?
Astoria: Salimos de Pociones para avisarles.

panels.scene: Ginny and Astoria head back through oak door. Pansy in green sweater gently waves with one hand. Hermione and Robin behind. No contact or extra person.
dialogue: Pansy: Regresen antes de que Snape las eche de menos.

pages.summary: Pansy se encarga de Robin. Al atardecer, los amigos bromean sobre la tardanza y hablan de las vacaciones.

panels.scene: Morning bedroom. Pansy fully dressed in forest green sweater supports one Robin in navy cardigan securely, Hermione in burgundy beside her with one folded towel, heading to closed washroom door. No bathing depicted.
dialogue: Pansy: Yo me encargo de él esta mañana.

panels.scene: Wide view at December dusk, Slytherin common room. All friends in school uniforms with babies safely held on green chairs and black sofa. Pansy and Hermione sit side by side with one Robin. Cold blue windows and warm left fire.
panels.caption: Al atardecer, el grupo se reunió junto al fuego.

panels.scene: Ginny holds one cup of hot chocolate and imitates a stern professor with funny raised brow. James safely on her lap with black hair and cream sweater, cup in other hand away from him.
dialogue: Ginny: ¡Y cincuenta puntos por aparecer a las diez!

panels.scene: Theo laughs gently in green uniform next to Luna in blue-bronze, twins on their separate laps, both secure. Theo has male short brown curls, Luna long pale blonde.
dialogue: Theo: Les falta instinto de supervivencia.

panels.scene: Pansy in green uniform gives Hermione an affectionate sidelong glance. Hermione lightly smooths Robin's brown curls. Both fully dressed, necklace front white platinum.
panels.caption: Pansy no habría cambiado aquella mañana.

panels.scene: Wide quiet group by fire. Hermione looks out toward cold blue underwater windows while friends talk over warm drinks and hold babies. One general transition caption.
panels.caption: Solo faltaba una semana para las vacaciones de Navidad.
